description: Source code for RTP packet handling, including classes for RTP, audio, and control packets, with methods for setting properties, serialization, and packing RTP packets.

classes.name: TRTPPacket
classes.description: Base class for RTP packets, providing serialization and property management.

classes.name: TRTPAudioPacket
classes.description: Derived class for RTP audio packets, with additional audio-specific properties.

classes.name: TRTPControlPacket
classes.description: Derived class for RTP control packets, with command-specific properties.

methods.name: setSeqNumber
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the RTP packet.

methods.name: getSeqNumber
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the RTP packet.

methods.name: setPTS
methods.description: Sets the presentation timestamp for the RTP packet.

methods.name: getPTS
methods.description: Returns the presentation timestamp.

methods.name: setEpoch
methods.description: Sets the epoch value for the RTP packet.

methods.name: setProgramID
methods.description: Sets the program ID for the RTP packet.

methods.name: setSubstreamID
methods.description: Sets the substream ID for the RTP packet.

methods.name: setClockTransform
methods.description: Sets the clock transformation for the RTP packet.

methods.name: getPacket
methods.description: Returns the pointer to the packed RTP packet data.

methods.name: getPacketLen
methods.description: Returns the length of the packed RTP packet.

methods.name: setExpireTime
methods.description: Sets the expiration time for the RTP packet.

methods.name: getExpireTime
methods.description: Returns the expiration time.

methods.name: setCodecType
methods.description: Sets the codec type for the audio RTP packet.

methods.name: setRandomAccessPoint
methods.description: Marks the packet as a random access point.

methods.name: setDropable
methods.description: Marks the packet as dropable.

methods.name: setDiscontinuity
methods.description: Marks the packet as a discontinuity.

methods.name: setEndOfStream
methods.description: Marks the packet as end of stream.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the audio packet.

methods.name: setAccessUnitData
methods.description: Sets the access unit data for the audio packet.

methods.name: setAuxData
methods.description: Sets auxiliary data for the audio packet.

methods.name: setCommandID
methods.description: Sets the command ID for control packets.

methods.name: writeU8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned value into buffer.

methods.name: writeU16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned value into buffer.

methods.name: writeU32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned value into buffer.

methods.name: writeU64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned value into buffer.

methods.name: writeTRTPHeader
methods.description: Serializes the RTP and TRTP headers into buffer.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the packet data into a packed RTP packet.

methods.name: TRTPHeaderLen
methods.description: Calculates the length of the RTP header including optional parts.
